meta.title: BUREX Studio | Web Design for Businesses
meta.desc: BUREX Studio designs modern, fast websites that help businesses build trust and win more customers.
hero.title: Websites built to turn visitors into customers.
hero.sub: We design modern, high-performing websites that help businesses stand out, build trust, and turn online visitors into real opportunities.
benefits.title: Your website should do more than look good.
benefits.text: A website should help your business build trust and create opportunities. Every page we design has a clear purpose.
benefits.1.d: Clean, polished visuals that reflect the quality of your business.
benefits.2.d: Built to work beautifully on phones before anything else.
benefits.3.d: Lightweight pages that load quickly and keep visitors engaged.
benefits.4.d: Clear layouts and calls to action that guide visitors to get in touch.
services.title: Digital solutions built around your business.
services.1.d: Modern, professional websites tailored to your business and its goals.
services.2.d: Focused pages designed to present your offer and encourage visitors to take action.
services.3.d: Seamless experiences across desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
services.4.d: Transform outdated websites into modern, functional digital experiences.
services.5.d: Essential on-page optimization to help search engines understand your website.
services.6.d: Ongoing support, updates, and improvements to keep your website working smoothly.

process.title: From idea to launch.
process.1.d: We learn about your business, your goals, and what your website needs to achieve.
process.2.d: We create a modern visual experience aligned with your brand.
process.3.d: We turn the design into a responsive, functional, and optimized website.
process.4.d: We prepare your website for publication and help bring your new digital presence online.
about.title: Small studio. Big ambitions.
about.text: BUREX Studio is an independent web design studio focused on creating modern digital experiences for businesses around the world. We believe great websites combine thoughtful design, functionality, and clear communication.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions.
faq.1.q: How do I start a project?
faq.1.a: Simply complete our project inquiry form. We'll review your request and get back to you by email.
faq.2.q: Do you work with international clients?
faq.2.a: Yes. We work remotely and welcome projects from businesses around the world.
faq.3.q: How long does a website take?
faq.3.a: Timelines depend on the size and complexity of each project. We'll discuss an estimated schedule after reviewing your requirements.
faq.4.q: Can you redesign my existing website?
faq.4.a: Yes. We can help modernize your website's design, structure, and user experience.
faq.5.q: How do we communicate during the project?
faq.5.a: Communication is primarily handled through email, making it easy to share updates, feedback, and project details.
